margin.why: The Morpho app reads its own preview when it builds the transaction, accrued two hours ahead (computeVaultMaxSharePrice and computeVaultMaxShareAllowance in packages/morpho-sdk/src/helpers/slippage.ts at the same commit). The share price moves between this card and then, up with interest or down with a Vault V2 fee, and with the default alone a move against the card makes the app's own transaction MISMATCH. 0.07% more covers about three days of a vault earning 8% a year.

calls.function: vaultBundlesV1Deposit(address vault, uint256 assets, uint256 maxSharePriceE27, (uint8 kind, bytes data) assetPermit, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)

free.unread: TokenLib.pullToken reads the permit data only for kind 1 (ERC-2612) or 2 (Permit2); kind is bound to 0, which pulls the amount with transferFrom

deadline.free: a time after which the call reverts; it limits when the deposit can run, not what it does

trailer.why: the Morpho app appends a 4-byte timestamp and one or two 4-byte origin tags (morpho-org/sdks, addTransactionMetadata); vaultBundlesV1Deposit reads only its arguments
